messages.subject: normalization options in copy number analysis
parts:
Hi,

Ken thanks for your replies.

I was wondering if in the copy number workflow, for normalization is
there a option for invariant set normalization that I can use instead
of the default RMA?

thanks
Manisha

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] normalization options in copy number analysis
parts:
No, invariant set normalization is not implemented/ported. For
someone fluent in R it should not hard to write a wrapper to the
existing Bioconductor implementations, although I don't know about the
memory efficiency.

/Henrik
